payload.title: File:Carcharocles (or Otodus) megalodon.jpg
payload.artist_html: Antonio Rares Mihaila
payload.description_html: My reconstruction is based on Cretalamna (for jaw morphology) and Cretoxyrhina (for the head shape, but i make it with a shorter snout for great bite and a huge post-head muscular hump), Alopias genus (also for head shape), Great White shark (for fin proportions, but I added a wider pectoral, dorsal and caudal fins), Killer Whale (for countershading)
